title: The Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 Cap Centre show with a killer Playin > Crazy Fingers sequence, captured on a solid matrix mix that clears up after a rough start.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the scorching first set and the unique Playin/Crazy Fingers combo that carries through the night, highlighting Let It Grow, Shakedown, Good Lovin' and the historic first‑time Touch of Grey encore. The recording is a soundboard‑plus‑audience matrix; while the opening moments are a bit muddy, the mix settles into clear, balanced sound for the bulk of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.2; comments consistently praise the musical performance and note only minor recording flaws, giving a strong positive overall impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rough and slightly muffled at the very beginning, then clears up to a crisp, well‑balanced soundboard‑plus‑audience mix. No major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique setlist with Playin/Crazy Fingers jam opening the first set, high‑energy flow throughout, and a solid second set that keeps the band bouncy and tight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry's guitar work – 'great noodles', 'tears it up' on Shakedown and Let It Grow.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards are highlighted as a strength; reviewers note he’s hit his stride and adds confidence to the band, despite occasional criticism of his Shakedown solo.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums segment singled out as 'sick' by one reviewer; overall drum work considered solid.
